verdict.rationale: Asaas is a payments/BaaS SaaS platform that processes customer data, so a buyer can fairly ask whether that data is excluded from AI model training. The evidence pack contains no AI-training opt-out, data-use policy, or no-training commitment. The MCP server and llms.txt items concern AI access to public documentation, not customer data use, and the PCI-DSS item covers card-data scope, not AI training.
